title: Chrome Larynx
description: An FM lead in the mid register with a clangorous metallic core: the FM index swells and the harmonicity ratio steps through inharmonic values so the timbre keeps re-tuning itself. A stereo-drifting pan LFO and a jux-reversed echo throw the voice across the field while a slow band-pass sweep and cycling vowel formants morph it from a hollow chime into a screaming metallic creature over a 16-cycle arc.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 [eb4 g4] bb3 <f4 a4>>/2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(2, 11)).fmh("<1.41 2.76 0.5 3.33>/8")
    .vowel("<a e o i>/4")
    .vib("<5 7 11>/8").vibmod(tri.slow(13).range(0.2, 1.3))
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(500, 3600)).resonance(16)
    .crush("<16 10 8 12>/16").shape(0.3)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .jux(rev)
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).pan(saw.slow(9).range(0.85, 0.15)))
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.2).sustain(0.6).release(0.12)
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").room(0.6).gain(0.78)
)
